text:
Maya: Found the Golden Paperclip under the whiteboard bench. :eyes:
Ronen: Wait, THE Golden Paperclip? Thought it ascended during the Great Clip Migration.
Liz: This requires an official handoff. Lunch meeting?
Maya: proposing custody rules: 24h possession to the person who fixes the most annoying lint warning. :scroll:
ops-bot: Note: Office artifacts should not be used as keychains. Policy 3.4.1. :rotating_light:
Tasha: i actually left a trail of post-its, guilty as charged. shepherding duties accepted. :sheep:
Liz: quick poll: rename suggestions: "Clip of Commitment" (:one:) or "Golden Binder" (:two:). react.
Maya: :one:
Ronen: :two: dramatic.
Sam (design): i can design a tiny plaque/box. metal plaque or sticker? :art:
Maya: metal for permanence.
Ronen: metal + tiny velvet pouch. mandatory.
Liz: filing ticket ART-1 "Golden Paperclip Plaque" and assigning to @Sam (design). deadline: next all-hands.
Sam (design): got it. will mock up options and a ceremonial script. :package:
Maya: Proposed ritual:
```
Ceremony of the Golden Paperclip
1) Gather at the kitchen table
2) Recite: "I shall not hoard office supplies"
3) Pass the clip clockwise
4) Photo for the archive
```
Liz: saving to #lore. will bring confetti (optional).
Tasha: honored to be the clip's first shepherd. see you at noon. :tea:
